THE BR-DGE

Meet us at THE BR-DGE, the center of gravity for space innovation.

THE BR-DGE catalyzes an innovation ecosystem that supports entrepreneurs building space capabilities for the new space economy, a commercial space sector projected to grow to $1.8 trillion dollars by 2035 from $630 billion dollars in 2023 - almost twice the rate of global GDP growth.

OUR PROGRAMS

Launchpad Sessions In-Person & Virtual

Designed for new startups and non-traditional vendors, Launchpad Sessions offer an immersive introduction to the SpaceWERX pipeline. These sessions provide an overview of the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) programs, followed by in-depth discussion and personalized guidance to address your unique needs.

Attendees also have the opportunity to schedule a follow-up 'Office Hours' session with the DTI program management team for deeper guidance. Launchpad Sessions are available twice a month and are offered both in-person at THE BR-DGE in El Segundo, California, and virtually.

Click here to register for a Launchpad Session

Launchpad Office Hours

Available exclusively to Launchpad attendees and I2A Cohorts and Alumni, office hours provide tailored one-on-one sessions designed to meet your team’s unique needs. The sessions cover a range of topics including guidance on applying for SBIR/STTR programs, recommendations for selecting the right entry platform, strategic advice for business development efforts and opportunities to connect with I2A companies pursuing advanced Phase III, STRATFI or TACFI awards.

THE BR-DGE Industry Mixer

Our popular quarterly event, THE BR-DGE Industry Mixer, allows you to connect and network with a dynamic community of innovators, leaders and organizations from the government, public and private sectors. Exchange ideas, explore emerging challenges and opportunities in the space industry and build meaningful relationships in an engaging, in-person setting. All are welcome!

Click here to register for THE BR-DGE Industry Mixer

Innovate to Accelerate (I2A)

As THE BR-DGE’s signature program, I2A supports high-tech small businesses in the SpaceWERX Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR)/Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) program by addressing ecosystem gaps through enhanced access to knowledge, networks and capital, ensuring successful commercialization during their SBIR Phase II contract lifecycle.

This 12-week program supports a cohort of SBIR Phase II awardees tackling critical Space Force challenges. Through expert-led sessions, strategic mentorship and direct engagement with government, industry and investors, I2A provides participants with the resources needed to transition cutting-edge space technologies from concept to commercialization and operational impact.

Upon curriculum completion, companies join an alumni network with ongoing engagement, access to resources, opportunities to foster partnerships and accelerate commercialization opportunities.
